history.ask.title: Revert AI changes?

history.ask.text.one: Revert # AI change? Your own edits made after it stay. Undo brings it back.
history.ask.text.other: Revert # AI changes? Your own edits made after them stay. Undo brings them back.

history.conflict: Not reverted: the later step “{step}” changed {what}. Undo that step first. Nothing was changed.
history.conflict_any: Not reverted: a later edit changed {what}. Undo that edit first. Nothing was changed.
